summary.en: A low camera flies over a data landscape: a bright trunk line winds to a vanishing point, tributaries sweep in and merge, pins rise on them, pulses flow, the vanishing point lights and a two-line title lands in the sky.
summary.zh: 低空镜头在一片数据地景上前飞：一条亮主干蜿蜒奔向消失点，两侧支流切向汇入，支流上立起标签，脉冲流向汇点，汇点亮起，天空落下两行标题。

fits: The first shot of an opening about many things becoming one: many inputs into one output, many contributors into one release, many sources into one pipeline; a mood-setting world before the product is named.
notFor: Light, flat or paper styles (it needs a dark ground for the light to read); content that must be read in detail (the pins are glances); slots under 6 seconds.

intent.en: Set a world before naming anything: countless streams of work flowing into one trunk, seen from a low camera gliding over them, so the product is felt as what all that work becomes.
intent.zh: 在说出任何名字之前先立一个世界：无数工作流汇进一条主干，从低空缓缓飞越，观众先感到“这么多东西汇成了一个产品”。

content.en: 3–6 pins naming the streams (en ≤ 16 chars, zh ≤ 6, numbered), an optional eyebrow (en ≤ 28, zh ≤ 10) and a two-line title (line 1 en ≤ 16 / zh ≤ 7, line 2 en ≤ 24 / zh ≤ 9).
content.zh: 3–6 个标签，给各条支流命名（英文 ≤ 16 字符，中文 ≤ 6 字，自动编号），可选眉标（英文 ≤ 28，中文 ≤ 10），两行标题（第一行英文 ≤ 16 / 中文 ≤ 7，第二行英文 ≤ 24 / 中文 ≤ 9）。

fits.zh: 讲“很多东西汇成一个”的开场第一镜：很多输入汇成一个输出、很多贡献者汇成一次发布、很多来源汇成一条流水线；产品被点名之前先立氛围的世界。

notFor.zh: 浅色、平面或纸感风格（光要暗底才读得出）；要细读的内容（标签只是一瞥）；短于 6 秒的槽位。

pairs.note: the lit vanishing point hands over to the brand lockup

en: Do not put it next to another dark glowing-line passage; back to back they read as the film's only trick, so keep two light shots between them.
Grade the line brightness by depth; all lines at full white mat into a cobweb, and no glow at all reads as a wireframe.
Cutting from it into a light product passage needs a hidden-cut transition, not a straight cut from dark to light.
Keep the pin labels at least 18 px equivalent, or they become decorative noise.
zh: 别和别的暗场发光线段落相邻；背靠背读作全片只会一招，中间至少隔两个亮场镜头。
线条亮度按纵深分层；全部纯白会糊成蛛网，完全没辉光又读作线框图。
接亮场产品段要用藏切类转场垫，别从暗到亮生切。
标签字号等效不小于 18 px，否则沦为装饰噪点。

upstream.summary: 暗场支流线束地景开场——多条流线汇入主干、虚构 ID 标签浮在线上、相机重景深低速飞越
